notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.notes:
Hello It's Blake and I got some news for you and I hope you are all ready for a rootin time!

Demo will be released tomorrow and it is going to be a really early build.

You may walk around from Mexico, Texas and New Mexico and back and fourth. You may enter the cantina but the owner isn't ready to sell just yet...

You may travel back and fourth between the underworld and over world and the slimes spawn and you can fight them.

This and the cows are eating but need alot of work.

So at this point the demo is the style of the old ps2 demos we got as kids in those magazines.

I will be leaving the demo up permanently and it will give me the ability to update is as it is played.
Also this gives me the perfect timing for feed back and telling me if there is anything I can iron out before a early release.

Thank you to everyone who is supporting me in this adventure being one guy takes a lot of effort but lucky for me art making and music was the first things I surrounded myself with in life so that part is the easy peasy. It's scripting that holds me back but we will prevail 

Games for Gamers! Always

AggressiveKiwi Out!
